optimizationRules.reason: Heavily scripted servers are CPU-bound; stable clocks help the 1% lows.

graphicsGuidance.title: Server content dominates
graphicsGuidance.detail: Frame rate depends mostly on the server's streamed assets and scripts; compare benchmarks on the same server and location.

graphicsGuidance.title: Extended Texture Budget
graphicsGuidance.detail: Raise it if you see texture pop-in and have spare VRAM; watch VRAM usage in the STORM overlay.

networkGuidance.title: Server region
networkGuidance.detail: Latency to the game server matters more than internet speed; pick servers close to you.
